title.en: Village notice board with mixed typography
title.zh: 混合排版的乡村公告板

summary.en: Arrange seven different notice-board elements while keeping their formats distinct.
summary.zh: 排列七类公告板元素，并保持各自的排版形式。

model.evidence: The creator’s parent comparison post names GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and identifies the right-hand result as 2.5; output model not independently verified.

steps.en: a cork notice board outside a Welsh village post office, overcast light, seven pinned items. A choral society flyer, a lost cat poster on yellow paper, a handwritten piano card, a bus timetable with four times, a sheepdog photo, tear off tabs, and one blank white card.
steps.zh: 威尔士乡村邮局外的一块软木公告板，阴天光线，上面钉着七项内容：合唱团传单、黄色纸张的寻猫启事、手写钢琴课程卡、列出四个时间的公交时刻表、牧羊犬照片、可撕下的小条，以及一张空白白色卡片。

notes.en: The creator’s parent thread identifies GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and says GPT Image 2 is on the left and 2.5 on the right. This preview links the second source image. This is a creator claim, not a maintainer test.
notes.zh: 作者在线程首帖中标明 GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst，并说明左侧为 GPT Image 2、右侧为 2.5。此处预览链接第二张原帖图片。这是作者声明，不是维护者复测。
